name: Shuffle 'N' Cut Worlds Celebration Event

notes:

R1: Yijie Dou — Alakazam Toucannon (L)
Couldn't find stadium to replace Nighttime Mine.

R2: Anthony Ting — Crustle (L)
Duskull and Psychic Energy prized. Tails on Crushing Hammers.

R3: Bye (W)

R4: Max Zheng — Dragapult Dusknoir (W)
Poor start, but opponent misplayed hugely to let me win.

R5: CJ Hewitt — Marnie's Grimmsnarl (L)
Close set, missed early energy attachment so forced to Crispin instead of Boss. Opponent found late-game Boss for game.

Post event reflection:
• Straight Dragapult might have run better given my matchups.
• I paired two strong players in R1 and R2 who both played decks to beat mine, so losing to them isn't so bad.

notes:
5 rounds BO1 Swiss.

R1: Tom Layburn — Dragapult mirror (L)
Drew dead at the start of the game, lost before turn 3.

R2: Meredith Whitehead — Dragapult mirror (L)
Felt like I misplayed some bench sniping maths. Preemptively benched Fezandipiti which cost me 2 prizes - I was trying to play around Unfair Stamp. In the end, I got stamped anyway. Still had a way to win but 3rd Dragapult was prized.

R3: Ryan Flood — Dragapult mirror (L)
Dead drew again - didn't even evolve into Drakloak. No outs to Meowth.

Overall reflection:
• Sucks to lose to dead draws but that can happen in BO1 scenario.
• I need to get better at learning prize maths and optimal targets in match ups - for eg. R2 I KO'd Drakloak leaving Munkidori alive, which in the end was pivotal for some key math for my opponent.
• I'm considering playing Alakazam at the next event however I have zero practice playing that deck.

Pre-event notes:
I wanted to play something different to Dragapult, and since I had 60 cards for this deck and I expect fewer Dragapult in a small meta, I think Rocket's Mewtwo might be suitable. I tested a few games on PTCGL the day before, and it seemed okay. Susceptible to Unfair Stamp but the prize trade is mostly favourable and cards like Team Rocket's Transceiver can luck you out.

• Learnt in testing and from watching clips online that Spidops is the preferred attacker mostly - apart from when an OHKO is needed with Mewtwo.
• Maximum Belt only works on ex Pokémon - have to remember.

R1: Brendan S — Mega Lucario (W)
Opponent dead drew. Over in 5 minutes.

R2: Ciaran B — Rocket's Honchkrow (W)
Tight game trading prizes. He missed a KO on one turn, which let me get ahead.

R3: Tom L — Dragapult (L)
Misplayed, but was still in with a chance — didn't draw Team Rocket's Energy in time to win.

R4: Ifran N — Alakazam (W)
Should be an auto-win for my deck thanks to Articuno, but I didn't realise this and nearly cost myself the game.

Post event reflection:
• Dragapult should in theory be a favoured matchup — learned a bit about how to play it better.
• Vs Alakazam: bait out the Enhanced Hammers, and don't evolve too early.
